_about: One vertical of the seed catalogue (specs/156): the shop sells anything, and cameras were only its first example.
Real brands and products, so the storefront shows things a person recognises. Descriptions are written here.
⚠️ THE PRICES ARE APPROXIMATE AND NOBODY HAS CHECKED THEM AGAINST A SHOP - the same warning as cameras.json.
They are the right order of magnitude and the right relative order, from a model's knowledge up to May 2026.
The dong and dollar prices are each that market's, never a conversion (specs/022).
No photographs: products read back with imageUrl null and show the storefront's parcel tile (specs/156).
